selection.entropy_definition: mean of per-view entropy divided by log(10)
selection.percentile_definition: average tie rank divided by class_size-1; values lie in [0,1], but ties may prevent attaining either endpoint; no min-max stretching
selection.sampling: identity-keyed shared Gumbel top-k without replacement

student.normalization_layer: GroupNorm(C,C), called instance in released code

augmentation.tensor_boundary: after CenterCrop: RGB float32 Tensor in [0,1], before RRC
augmentation.paired_randomness: SHA-256 namespace x student_seed x epoch x image identity; does not reset global RNG

supervision.hard: ordinary mean CE against true class
supervision.soft1: ordinary mean soft-target CE; teacher T=1 and student T=1
supervision.teacher: one fixed C1 ResNet18 checkpoint; eval, frozen, no_grad; same augmented pixels as student

metrics.diagnostic: Best test Top-1 sampled every 20 epochs
